Roosevelt) approves the Code of Fair Competition for the Legitimate Full Length Dramatic and Musical Theatrical Industry under Title I of the National Industrial Recovery Act, on the application and the Administrator's report, with no other command. Identity: the census register row, the WPA 1944 numbered list entry at p. 536 (August 16, 1933) and the held text agree on number, date and subject. savings_reason: Nothing continues the approval after the repeal. Acts done and liabilities incurred under the code approved by this order before June 14, 1935 are accrued consequences, not continued operation of EO 6250. No held source shows a prosecution continued or any action under the code taken after June 14, 1935.
earlier_end_check: No held record shows the code approved or changed by EO 6250 cancelled, suspended, superseded or revoked before June 14, 1935.
